rationale: Build entries by run 1-5: succeeded, not_declared, not_declared, succeeded, not_declared. Declared run-command probes: succeeded, succeeded, succeeded, succeeded, succeeded. Every declared build command and run-command probe completes successfully across the five runs.
limitation: Undeclared build commands are not counted as successful builds. HTTP listening or a successful CLI entry does not establish requirement fulfillment.

rationale: FR-013: submitting an empty store name produces Store name is required in run 1, but run 2 records Basic store information saved with no incomplete-entry flag. The same incomplete-setup condition produces different feedback. Reviewed coverage: 48/71 requirements have an observed status in at least one run; 124/355 requirement-run cells have an observed status. These counts describe coverage, not stability.
limitation: Only the empty-store-name setup condition is compared. Unobserved branches cannot establish further variation; no causal attribution to SRS omissions is made.

rationale: EX-005: invalid checkout in run 4 returns the checkout form with field-specific corrections. Run 5 returns only a plain-text required-information error. The recorded validation responses differ in retaining the checkout-page interface. Reviewed coverage: 7/17 requirements have an observed status in at least one run; 19/85 requirement-run cells have an observed status. These counts describe coverage, not stability.
limitation: The initial checkout-page state in run 5 was not recorded; this contrast concerns the returned validation interface, not session continuity. Unobserved branches cannot establish further variation; no causal attribution to SRS omissions is made.
